items.title: 【远程/全职】诚聘资深智能合约工程师 （RWA/Tokenization)
items.description:
关于我们
Anchored Finance 是一家领先的金融科技及代币化基础设施公司。我们正在寻找一位经验丰富的资深智能合约工程师。该岗位将负责公司RWA及资产代币化相关智能合约的设计、开发与维护。理想的候选人应具备扎实的Solidity 开发经验，并对RWA、资产代币化及智能合约安全有良好的理解。

岗位职责

负责 Anchored RWA 及资产代币化相关智能合约的架构设计、开发、部署与维护，为股票、基金及其他现实世界资产的链上发行、赎回、转让和结算提供安全、可靠的技术支持。
设计和实现资产发行与销毁、申购与赎回、资产转让、权限控制、白名单管理等核心链上功能。
与产品、后端、合规及业务团队紧密协作，根据业务及合规需求设计并实现相应的智能合约逻辑。
编写高质量、安全、可维护且可审计的 Solidity 代码，负责代码审查、测试、Gas 优化及智能合约安全，并配合第三方安全审计。
持续关注 RWA、资产代币化及智能合约相关技术和标准的发展，为产品及技术架构优化提供建议。
岗位要求

本科及以上学历，计算机科学、软件工程、数学、金融工程或相关专业优秀院校背景优先。
具备 5 年以上软件工程相关经验，其中至少 3 年生产级 Solidity 智能合约开发经验；具有核心智能合约设计、开发、部署及维护的实际经验。
精通 Solidity，熟悉 EVM 工作机制、Gas Optimization、Access Control、Upgradeable Contracts 等核心技术，并具备良好的智能合约安全意识。
熟悉智能合约开发、测试及部署流程，能够熟练使用 Foundry、Hardhat 等主流开发框架；至少熟悉一门其他开发语言，如 TypeScript / JavaScript、Python、Go 或 Rust。
对 RWA、资产代币化或链上金融产品具有一定理解，能够快速理解相关业务逻辑，并将产品需求转化为可靠的智能合约设计。
具备较强的独立解决问题能力、代码质量意识及团队协作能力，能够适应国际化、Remote 的工作环境。
优先考虑条件

有 RWA、Security Token、Tokenized Stocks、Tokenized Funds 或其他机构级数字资产相关项目经验。
熟悉 ERC-20，以及 ERC-3643、ERC-1400 等与资产代币化或受监管数字资产相关的 Token 标准。
有金融类智能合约、资产发行、申购赎回、权限控制、链上结算等相关开发经验。
有智能合约安全审计、Fuzz / Invariant Testing、Formal Verification 或第三方安全审计协作经验。
对证券、基金、Custody、Clearing & Settlement 等传统金融业务有一定了解。
有高质量开源项目贡献、GitHub 项目或其他能够体现智能合约架构及安全能力的技术成果。
薪资福利待遇
● 基本薪资： USD 5,000+
● 津贴/奖金： 根据绩效评估情况授予具有竞争力的团队 Token

工作要求
● 工作地点： Remote
● 工作性质： 全职
● 时区要求： GMT+8 优先
● 联系方式： 请发送简历至 [talent@anchored.finance](mailto:talent@anchored.finance)，并在邮件主题中注明：资深智能合约工程师_[你的名字]

items.description:
[Aven Careers.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31624057/Aven.Careers.pdf)

### Link to Internship Posting

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Aven/8b258254-e243-4bee-8767-3744623fffaf/application

### Company Name

Aven

### Internship Title

Software Engineering Intern (Winter & Summer 2027) | $95/hr

### Location

In Person / Bay Area 

### What term(s) is this internship offered for?

Summer 2027, Winter 2027

### Does this internship offer sponsorship?

Offers Sponsorship

### Is this internship currently accepting applications?

Yes

### What category does this internship belong to?

Software Engineering

### Advanced Degree Requirements

- [ ] This internship requires or strongly prefers advanced degrees (Master's/MBA/PhD)

### Email associated with your GitHub account (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

**Compensation: $95/hour + equity** | This is a fully in-person internship based in Campbell, CA.

### Job description
**About Us**

Aven is reinventing how traditional banks operate by rebuilding the industry from the ground up as a fully automated AI banking platform. Our mission is simple: to provide the lowest-cost, most transparent, and most convenient access to capital.

Consumer debt is at an all-time high, with over $1.2 trillion in credit card debt in the United States. Our goal is ambitious: to cut the nation’s debt in half within a decade. How? By treating banking as a computational problem rather than a manual one, we’ve unlocked a level of efficiency previously impossible in the sector

We do this by using in-house algorithms and robotics technology to unlock the value of assets people already own. Our flagship product is the world’s first AI-powered credit card backed by home equity, giving consumers the convenience of a card with the low interest rates. Using patented technology and AI-driven automation, we’ve reduced a process that traditionally takes 6 weeks and thousands of dollars into a fully digital experience that can take as little as 15 minutes at $0.

Aven isn’t just a lender; we are one of the most efficient financial engines in existence. By automating the core systems that traditional banks manually maintain, we generate over $4.5M in revenue per employee. This radical efficiency allows us to pass every cent of overhead savings back to the consumer through $0 start-up costs and unprecedented interest rates.

We’re backed by leading investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, NYCA, and Max Levchin.  We’ve assembled a lean, elite, and collective of builders recruited from the most iconic engineering cultures. Our team is composed of the architects and lead engineers who scaled systems at Meta, Microsoft, Google, Uber, and Tesla, combined with the financial minds who redefined fintech at Goldman Sachs, Capital One, and Square.

**Who are you?**

You’re an engineer graduating in 2028 or 2029 who is passionate about building consumer products. You thrive in fast-paced environments and have experience (through internships, projects, or coursework) with metrics-driven, iterative product development. You enjoy working closely with customer support and servicing teams to deeply understand and solve real customer problems. You care about prioritizing work based on measurable impact and driving toward clear, outcome-driven goals.

You think about performance under all network conditions and design for graceful degradation. You notice the debounce time on a typeahead, the responsiveness of layouts across devices, and the subtle UI contrast that boosts engagement. You’re thoughtful about how every new feature fits into the broader user experience.

**You can expect to work on**
- Anything and everything. At this early stage, you will find yourself:
- Building a best in class credit card origination flow
- Building a best in class video notarization solution
- Helping us execute world-class growth & engagement tactics for our product
- Architecting core product infrastructure to enable us to go from 0-to-1
- Weighing in on strategy. Every voice is important to help inform our decisions
- Influencing our tech stack.
- Defining our culture. As a large % of the team, who you are shapes who we become.
- Become an expert in our product space, such that you're able to define how products should work end-to-end.

**You should join us if**

- You have led large, technically complex projects with a lot of moving parts
- You have a lot of experience with a lot of disparate systems
- You have worked on production-grade compilers, operating systems, or large distributed systems
- You can jump into a new environment and hit the ground running without much hand holding
- You’re fine with us not having answers yet. You want to be part of figuring out the answers
- You thrive in highly collaborative environments and are down to riff with us on anything from company mission to software architecture to user research
- You enjoy diving into the deep end and feel like that’s where the greatest personal growth happens
- You are fearless about learning the details, and understanding every single minute detail of an underlying system or process

items.title: [Remoto ]  Full-stack Engineer (HealthTech, EHR/EMR, Terraform, React) USD - Strider
items.description:
#  [VAGA REMOTA] Full-stack Engineer (HealthTech, EHR/EMR, Terraform, React)

> **Salário:** $4,550 – $5,600 USD/mês  
> **Contratação:** Full-time (40h/semana) - Longo prazo  
> **Idioma:** Inglês C1+  
> **Experiência:** 5+ anos  
> **Modalidade:** 100% Remoto  

### 📌 Sobre a Oportunidade
Buscamos um(a) Full-stack Engineer sênior focado em alta confiabilidade, segurança e integração de sistemas de saúde. O papel envolve o desenvolvimento em React/TypeScript, gerenciamento de banco de dados PostgreSQL, testes com TDD e provisionamento de infraestrutura via Terraform.

### 🛠️ Tech Stack & Requisitos
- **Front-end & Lógica:** React.js, TypeScript, Git.
- **Banco de Dados & Infra:** PostgreSQL, Terraform (Infrastructure as Code - IaC).
- **HealthTech:** Experiência com integração de sistemas EHR/EMR, APIs clínicas e plataformas de dados de saúde.
- **Engenharia & Qualidade:** Domínio de TDD (Test-Driven Development), testes automatizados, escalabilidade e segurança da informação.
- **Processos:** Scrum/Agile e comunicação fluente em inglês (C1+).

###  Diferenciais (Nice-to-have)
- Padrões de troca de dados em saúde: **FHIR, HL7**
- Vivência prévia em Startups
- Integrações avançadas com fornecedores de EHR/EMR
- Uso de ferramentas/frameworks de IA em produção

---

### 📩 Como se candidatar
Acesse a aplicação no link:  
👉 [Candidatar-se para Full-stack Engineer (HealthTech)](https://app.onstrider.com/r/claudiaantunes?job=ZnVsbC1zdGFjay1lbmdpbmVlci0xZGVmZDE2NT9yZWZlcnJhbD1jbGF1ZGlhYW50dW5lcw==)
